capabilities: Sync a vault to a private GitHub repository on desktop and mobile
Authenticate with GitHub via the device code flow
Preserve both versions of conflicting edits with timestamped .conflict files
Browse and restore past versions of notes
Exclude files using glob ignore patterns
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the OAuth token is stored locally in the vault at .obsidian/plugins/supersync/data.json.
intentEvidence: Unlike other git plugins, SuperSync doesn't need Git installed on your device
problem: Git-based vault sync plugins require Git and command-line setup, which is impractical on mobile devices like iOS and Android.

relations.evidence: It uses GitHub's official APIs under the hood

summary: GitHub-based sync plugin that backs up and syncs a vault to a private GitHub repository via the GitHub API, without needing Git installed.
